title: make check has no single-source scan: three P-IDs live outside the F01.5 master table (REQ-REU-002)
body:
[A10] Found by the compliance-matrix audit of `docs/00_MILAN_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW.md` at main 6a878f6 (owner request, 2026-09-18). The matrix Cov column grades the ORIGINAL architecture document; this ticket records what the tree carries today. Baseline at that head: `./scripts/run_suites.sh` exit 0 (30 of 30 suites, 14790 checks), `./scripts/lint_hdl.sh` exit 0.

## REQ-REU-002 (project charter, design) - audit verdict PARTIAL

One parameter master table with defaults and consumers; derived values referenced by ID, never copied

- In `hdl/` today: The table exists: docs/architecture/01_overview.md:137-175 (F01.5) and the single-source rules docs/README.md:68-79; RTL cites P-IDs (e.g. hdl/top/protocol_processor_top.sv:3927 P-EN-FIRMWARE-ASSIST, hdl/aecp/KL_aecp_notify.sv:19 P-N-AVB-INTERFACES; hdl/README.md:52-56 rule 4). The rule is already broken with nothing to catch it: P-MAAP-ACCEPT-CYC and P-MAAP-RSP-MS are used WITH VALUES outside F01.5 (docs/architecture/02_interfaces.md:260 '1024 cycles', :261 '10 s'; hdl/acmp/KL_acmp_talker.sv:129-141) and P-EN-TALKER-DYN-MAPPINGS-RUNNING is used at docs/architecture/06_aecp_engine.md:603 and :1167; none of the three has a row in 01_overview.md (F01.5 spells the third one differently, as MILAN_FEATURES_FLAGS.TALKER_DYNAMIC_MAPPINGS_WHILE_RUNNING, :170).
- In `tb/` today: Ver = lint, and no such gate exists: scripts/ (check-links.py, check-matrix.py, check_upc_map.py, gen_matrix.py, lint-diagrams.sh, render-wavedrom.py), Makefile and .github/workflows/hdl.yml contain no scan for P-IDs, F01.5 or parameter values (zero grep hits). docs/architecture/09_verification.md:166-168 records the single-source scan as 'To add once the generated environment exists', while docs/README.md:79 claims 'make check enforces the rest'. The one derived-value suite is tb/timer_map (1360/1360) for the timer-slot map only.
- Missing: The lint gate itself (a make check target that fails on a P-ID not defined in F01.5 and on a parameter value outside F01.5), and rows or renames for the three undefined P-IDs. docs/README.md:79 overstates what make check enforces.
- Searched with: F01\.5|F08\.1|single.source|P-[A-Z] in scripts/ Makefile .github/; timing value|parameter value in scripts/ Makefile; every P-ID token in docs/ hdl/ tb/ diffed against 01_overview.md; every T-ID token diffed against 08_timing.md (clean) (confidence: high)

## Acceptance

1. A make check target fails when a P- or T- ID used under docs/, hdl/ or tb/ has no row in F01.5 / F08.1
2. P-MAAP-ACCEPT-CYC, P-MAAP-RSP-MS and P-EN-TALKER-DYN-MAPPINGS-RUNNING gain F01.5 rows (or are renamed to existing ones) and 02_interfaces.md:260-261 stop carrying the values
3. docs/README.md section 2 and 09 section 8 agree on what is enforced today
4. The target runs in the docs-gates CI job

Matrix finding link: GAP-10.

Executor and reviewers: assigned when the lane opens.
